nodes.original_target: On a graded / time-sliced category with a commutative semiring of weights and finite fibers, the n-step propagator M^n equals the sum over length-n paths of products of edge weights, and M^(m+n)=M^m M^n. Finite shadow of sum over histories only.

For R a commutative ring and free module R^X, each generator acts as a transfer operator T_e; the finite transfer-matrix identity is an internal Fubini sum. The dual basis functional carries no metric (C8).
On the ungraded free category the a->b->c tree counts the two-step path three times (3:1), so the fiber decomposition is not injective without grading; one witness, not a general theorem.
If finite shadows are compatible under declared refinement maps and converge, a limit object is defined; without a convergence certificate the result is OracleNeeded and cannot be promoted.

Given a finite partition, finite carrier, endpoints and a declared discrete Lagrangian, the weighted history sum is a finite replayable computation; this shadow is the only Feynman content established. The Lagrangian is declared, not derived.

Continuous Hilbert-space differential equation, continuous Lie-group gauge lift, Minkowski light-cone causality and Kraus decomposition are each held as external L2 observer lifts; stub-style rows that share one claim: continuum non-promotion.

The graph equation i*hbar dpsi_v/dt = sum_w H_vw psi_w with Hermitian H conserves sum |psi_v|^2. The equation is posited from a Hermitian H; the quantity called L1 mass is the L2 norm squared. Not a derivation of the equation from the finite transport layer.

Unitary finite shadow, Hamiltonian generator admission, Dirac equation admission, spinor structure admission, Copenhagen as authority shadow and the 200-series slots 200/202/203/204/205 have 1-row ledgers that only reserve a slot. They contain no claim; recorded as OPEN, not as results. Papers carry release headers over internal stub bodies where I opened them (034, 035, 050, 051, 202, 203, 205).

Over Gaussian-integer 3x3 coordinate matrices the displayed P0, P1 are idempotent, Lambda1..3 are trace zero with [L1,L2]=2i L3 (cyclic), so trace zero holds while the commutator is nonzero: a finite local-green global-red witness. Representation choice is matrix form.
For a declared unitary U(t), A(t)=U^dagger A U satisfies dA/dt = i[H,A] on finite matrices. Depends on the unitary family and generator being given.

D_jk = Tr(C_j rho C_k^dagger) is imported with no representation bridge to the programme; positive semidefiniteness (rho>=0) and trace-one (completeness) are standard consequences under imported premises.
For D=(d11,d12,d22) in Z^3, globalWeight(D) - localDiagonalWeight(D) = 2 d12. Phase-class descent to H^1(G;U(1)) for a declared U(1) cocycle (C5) is OPEN.

In nonzero finite dimension, trace cyclicity gives tr[A,B] = 0 while tr(lambda I) = n lambda, so [A,B] = lambda I forces lambda = 0: canonical [X,P] = i hbar I has no finite-dimensional representation. Lean covers 2x2 integer matrices; Rust covers d=3 over Q(zeta_24).

For a declared finite unitary step, finite order is decided by cyclotomic characteristic factors with replay; the Lean example is the Pythagorean rotation (3/5,4/5), whose powers never return to the identity (pythagorean_rotation_order_infinite). Two bookkeeping theorems (periodic_sector_requires_declaration, aperiodic_sector_closure_no_declaration) hold by rfl on declared price constants and carry no independent mathematical content.

The two-state toggle has no report-level square root (no_bool_half_step); complex interpolants are not unique because of matrix-logarithm branches (interpolant_not_unique, branch_ambiguity_distinct, stone_discrete_generator_ambiguity); dense-orbit closure already uses an ambient topology and selects no one-parameter interpolation.

Equal-weight branch counting in a forking tree reproduces Born weights iff all weights are rational. For Born weights in Q(zeta_n)^+ minus Q (witness conductor 5, weights (5 +- sqrt5)/10) no finite integer fine-graining N = sum m_j gives m_j/N = w_j (witness polynomial 5x^2-5x+1 has no rational root).

Positivity of a mixed-state witness depends on the real embedding of Q(zeta_n)^+ (phi(n)/2 embeddings; 16 at n=120). Pure-state Gram matrices are totally positive in dimension 2 (pure_state_totally_positive_2d), but the mixed witness diag(sqrt5-2, 3-sqrt5) at conductor 5 is PSD under one embedding and indefinite under another. Choice of embedding is an external declaration.

Continuous time and the Stone theorem are not constructed: strong continuity, one-parameter group and generator selection are priced interfaces; rational entries alone do not imply infinite order. Causal order between events is also admitted externally (GAP-C1000-001, declared_assumption, non-blocking): Q(zeta_n) carriers supply no relation between spacetime events.

Complete positivity (K tensor I >= 0), Kraus/Choi/Stinespring forms and coherence transport above the classical kernel are imported; a positive map that is not completely positive shares the identity kernel (Rust test). Stinespring requires an extension (H063 header).

With a declared outcome-sector indicator S (Z_S>0), selective update (condition on S, renormalize) is support-collapsing, idempotent, repeatable (p_S=1 after) and sector-preserving. Finite Bayesian conditioning; not the projection postulate, not a measurement-problem result.
